assumptions: the admitted world fiber is finite and complete for the stated source image and task
protected-effect sets are exact for each admitted world
expressibility and verification membership are exact within the frozen finite domain
evidence leaves form a disjoint exhaustive partition of the admitted world fiber

s0_law.name: common protected effect
s0_law.statement: selected effect belongs to first-turn-selectable, expressible-and-verifiable, and every admitted world's protected-effect set

s1_law.name: nonempty exhaustive evidence leaves
s1_law.statement: every leaf admits at least one world, leaves partition every world exactly once, and each selected effect is expressible-and-verifiable and protected in every world in that leaf

heuristic_law: heuristics may reorder the complete world fiber but cannot remove, duplicate, or add worlds
